nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: React component implementing a reusable, resizable bottom panel with tabs, a maximize/collapse header, and per-tab actions, decoupled from the Code Editor's ActionSystem so it can be reused by Settings and other modules.
nodes.languageNotes: All tabs stay mounted simultaneously and are toggled via display:none rather than conditional rendering, preserving each tab's internal state across switches.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions for the GenericBottomPanel component, covering tab configuration, per-tab action buttons, and the component's public prop shape.

nodes.name: useGenericBottomPanelResize.ts
nodes.summary: Custom React hook providing pure DOM drag-to-resize logic for the bottom panel, mutating element height directly via refs and requestAnimationFrame during drag and committing the final height only on mouseup.
nodes.languageNotes: Avoids React re-renders during drag by storing all transient state in refs and writing directly to the DOM style, only calling onHeightChange (a state update) once on mouseup; cleanup listeners are stored in a ref and invoked on unmount.

nodes.name: GenericBottomPanel
nodes.summary: Memoized functional component that renders the panel shell: resize handle, tab-pill header with per-tab actions and maximize/collapse/close controls, and all tab contents mounted simultaneously with visibility toggled via display:none.

nodes.name: useGenericBottomPanelResize
nodes.summary: Hook that attaches mousedown/mousemove/mouseup listeners to drag-resize the panel, clamping height between min/max bounds and committing the final value via the onHeightChange callback on mouseup.
